intro: Klockmort's Creation marks the successful forging of a specialized suit of armor in Ironforge's Tinker Town. Utilizing an unconventional technique devised by the master armorsmith Furen Longbeard, the gnome blacksmith Klockmort Spannerspan shapes raw materials into an extraordinarily resilient piece of gear.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here's your armor, friend. Furen's process worked brilliantly! Perfectly! Marvelously, truly!
You could run this armor over with a siege engine and it would spring right back into shape!
